label: copy-phase input r (fed-back r)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at the step where the model feeds back an r it already copied (99% of activation mass). It never fires on r during the original phase or on any other input, apart from a few weak activations on a fed-back g (mostly when b comes next). It is very sparse: only about 2% of copy-phase r steps cross the threshold, so precision is low. Rate is higher when the r sits in the middle-to-late part of the original (recall_idx 3-4 or the last position) and in longer sequences (L 8-9), and when the token to output next is b, j or h (out_tok b gives about 18% precision). None of these conditions is enough to lift precision much without losing recall.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=r (+4.47), phase=2 & out_tok=b (+3.71), prev_tok=v (+2.93), in_tok=r (+2.77), phase=2 & out_tok=j (+2.62), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+2.37). Lower it: orig5=- (-2.10), orig5=r (-1.73), prev_tok=z (-1.62), t=8 (-1.54).
